name: Room Meadow
tagline: Draw rooms to scale and place furniture at measured sizes.

pricing.notes: The entry lists the one-time pack. Separate subscriptions are available.
pricing.freeTier: Draw and save in the browser and export a watermarked PNG.

verdictSummary: A small editor can draw a room to scale and arrange a few pieces of furniture. Matching the full tool means handling door swings and furniture clearances, maintaining a furniture library and producing a printable scale PDF. The photo redesign tool is a separate image workflow.
coreLoopDIY: Draw a rectangular room from measurements, size and move furniture, then export a PNG.
whatYouLose: Clearance checks for doors and furniture
To-scale PDF with a materials list
moatNotes: Consistent geometry, a ready-to-use library and exports are the work that accumulates beyond the first prototype.
whyPeopleStillPay: The browser drawing tools are free. Paid credits can produce clean scale PDFs with a materials list or clean Photo Studio images.
notes: The product team submitted this profile with AI assistance. The prompt describes a smaller prototype for comparison.
prompt:
Build a local one-room floor-plan sketcher with React, TypeScript and Canvas 2D.
Use Vite and a small dependency footprint.
Draw a rectangular room with editable width and depth in centimetres.
Keep geometry in centimetres and use a separate transform for zoom and canvas size.
Display a scale bar and label each room dimension.
Add two furniture presets and allow numeric changes to width and depth.
Support dragging, 90-degree rotation and keyboard movement of furniture.
Provide visible numeric controls so furniture can be positioned without dragging.
Snap positions to a five-centimetre grid and keep objects inside the room.
Calculate the gap between selected rectangular furniture and the nearest wall.
Print gap dimensions as planning measurements.
Save the project in local storage and provide one-click PNG export.
Offer a sample room with a dining table and a chair.
Handle phone and laptop widths without changing stored dimensions.
Add a geometry test for a 60 cm gap, a rotated chair and zoom-independent dimensions.
Write a README covering startup, the supported scope and the local storage behavior.
